image_description: A large, teal and white blimp-style airship with 'DREAMLAND' text on the side is parked on a grassy field. The airship has an orange nose cone and a gondola suspended underneath. In the background, there are trees and a rocky cliff face featuring a carved human head (resembling Mount Rushmore). In the foreground, the roof of a silver car is visible.
